author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Marshmallow Laser Feast
summary: An art studio in London since 2012. It uses virtual reality, spatial sound and scientific data to translate invisible natural processes into bodily experience.

hero_image.alt: A darkened studio table holding a moss-and-terrain study model, optics and headsets, with people working at the lit far end of the room.
hero_image.caption: Landscape rebuilt as apparatus: the natural world staged so it can be entered.
